_comment:
'If this is defended by an action card, this has -2{p}.' Generic Action - Attack. Release note: 'If this is defended by two or more action cards, it still only gets -2{p} in total' -- i.e. a conditional continuous property, capped once, not a per-defender penalty.

DELIBERATE STUB -- the ENTIRE printed text is one clause and NO existing condition gates it correctly. Every route silently does the wrong thing:

(a) The natural shape, WHILE_STATIC on RECALC_ATTACK_POWER + conditions + MODIFY_ATTACK add -2 (spelling proven by wtr/barraging_brawnhide_red.json; the release-note cap falls out of the stage-8 window -- effect_types.py:4134-4144 applies the static mod transiently once per recalculation, never accumulating), needs a condition that tests whether ANY declared defender is an ACTION card. None exists:

  - DEFENDING_CARD_IS {"card_type": "Action"} has the right MATCHER (its want_types compare target.types+subtypes, condition_types.py:579-609, so 'Action' would match) but the wrong TIMING: outside the defence-recalc pass combat.defense_recalc_card is None and the filtered form returns False in EVERY state (condition_types.py:591-602). defense_recalc_card is set ONLY inside _recalculate_total_defense around the RECALC_DEFENSE dispatches (engine.py:2060, cleared 2067); RECALC_ATTACK_POWER is emitted once per recalculation (engine.py:1993) and never sets it. Authored this way the -2 would NEVER fire while looking implemented.

  - DEFENDING_CARD_COUNT counts defenders but filters only on equipment / power_gte_attack (condition_types.py:651-668) -- it cannot say 'action card'. "gte 1" unfiltered would grant -2 whenever defended by ANY card, over-applying in every game where a non-action card blocks (equipment blocks are ubiquitous) -- exactly the silent-wrongness class to avoid.

  - TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND is no fallback: _dsl_defend_listener dispatches to the DEFENDING card's slug (engine.py:1640-1646), never to the attack card, so an ability on freewheeling_renegades_red can never fire off someone else's defend; and even at the right time its conditions evaluate the SOURCE card, not the event-payload defender.

Generic fix that makes this authorable with ZERO new concepts: give DEFENDING_CARD_COUNT a type/subtype filter (it already has the count+comparison machinery), or let DEFENDING_CARD_IS fall back to scanning combat.defending_cards existentially when defense_recalc_card is None. The clause is then: WHILE_STATIC + [SOURCE_IS_ATTACK, <a defender is an Action card>] + MODIFY_ATTACK add -2.

Triage list named WHILE_STATIC / DEFENDING_CARD_IS / MODIFY_ATTACK -- all three types exist and compile; the composition fails on timing, which is invisible to a type-name audit. Sibling colours (yellow/blue) have identical text and the identical gap (.triage/freewheeling_renegades_yellow.json, _blue.json). Same-gap precedent: .drafts/bash_brute_red.json clause 1 ('defended by a Brute card'), deliberately left unauthored for the same reasons.
